note: AP-M6 fails a build where two spells in one caster's kit share a windup silhouette and are distinguished only by particle colour — RI-AI02 §D rejects the 'the colour of the light tells you' defence explicitly, and RI-MAG01 §F rejects it again. Distinctness here is TWO-DIMENSIONAL: the weight CLASS sets the gross body shape (how tall, how planted, how long), and the SCHOOL sets the arm and hand shape on top of it. Any two spells in a six-slot loadout therefore differ in class, in school, or in both, and a critic can measure the difference off the bone transforms without seeing a single particle.
reference_note: Behavioural reference only (A5 rule 2 — never cited for art direction). souls-behaviour/anim/telegraph/er-ER_Leyndell_Knight_w_The_Flame_of_Frenzy.gif: 34 frames at 100 ms, weapon driven vertically overhead and HELD there for the first ~41% of the clip before the slam; the tell is the raised silhouette, not the glow, and the fire on the ground outlives the swing. souls-behaviour/anim/telegraph/er-Lansseax_Lightning_1.gif: 22 frames at 40 ms, a distinct gather (neck up, wings wide) before any projectile exists. Both informed the class shapes below and neither is a source of a number: every value here is constructed.

cast_point.silhouette: One hand snapped forward from the hip, elbow locked, shoulders square, feet still walking. The smallest and shortest tell in the game — and the only cast that does not stop you.

cast_draw.silhouette: The catalyst drawn across the chest, the shoulders closing, then opening outward hard — a shove. The torso rotates and comes back; the arms cross the centreline, which no other cast class does.

cast_gather.silhouette: Both arms low and wide, weight sunk onto the back foot, catalyst at the hip, HEAD DOWN. The only cast that lowers the head — readable from directly behind, which is where a boss's other tells are worst.

cast_raise.silhouette: The catalyst raised vertically overhead in BOTH hands, spine arched back, chin up — held there for the whole startup — then driven down through the centreline. The tallest silhouette in the player's or an enemy's kit and the only one that adds height rather than width.

cast_kneel.silhouette: Kneeling, both palms flat on the ground. The only action in the game that puts the player below standing height for two and a half seconds, which is exactly why nobody does it in a fight.

sorcery.hand_shape: Fingers splayed hard, wrist broken back — the hand of someone throwing something they do not want to hold.

root_speech.hand_shape: Palm up and open, held close to the sternum, the other hand cupped beneath it. You are asking, not throwing.

warding.hand_shape: A flat blade of a hand drawn along a straight line, as if along a carved relief. The only school whose gesture has an edge.

veiling.hand_shape: Fingers folding inward one at a time, the arm withdrawing toward the body. Everything in this school is a retreat.
